content.comment_body: Hello, I need assistance with an issue regarding my [product_name] device with serial number [article_no] ("8DI,4DO") and an expansion module with serial number [article_no] ("4DI,4DO"). My questions are: 1) Is the base module compatible with the mentioned expansion module? 2) How can I determine the type of base module, such as ([article_no].Standard, [article_no].L, [article_no].LB11), which is required in the software? 3) When searching for my device in the software, I find a module with the same name ([article_no]) but fewer I/Os than my device. Please refer to the attached image. Also, how do I add the expansion module to the base module in the software, noting that the base module is not yet connected to the computer? Apologies for the lengthy post.

The device with order number [article_no] corresponds to the current [product_name] [version_no], listed as [product_name] [version_no] in device selection. The expansion module is compatible with this series. The address numbering for digital inputs and outputs is sequential: Base module - I1 to I8, Q1 to Q4; first digital expansion module - I9 to I12 (or I16 for DM 16), Q5 to Q8 (or Q12 for DM 16).
Here is a brief overview of the [article_no] base device series.
Thank you, this information was very helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: This discussion focuses on questions of compatibility and configuration between a [product_name] base module and its expansion module. Participants are mainly trying to identify the correct hardware version in the software and ensure the expansion is properly recognized and mapped for I/O. There is uncertainty about device selection in the software and about expanding I/O mapping when modules are added.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for clear instructions regarding compatibility between [product_name] modules, easy identification of hardware versions through the software, and step-by-step guidance for adding expansion modules.
